requirements.title: Return Shared Validation Responses
requirements.description: The workflow-health API must mount `scenario-validation/v1` and return status, severity-gated findings, metrics, maturity assessment, remediation, artifact references, and packed native workflow details from `ValidateScenario`.

validation.notes: Provider handler tests assert shared response fields, maturity-go construction, native detail packing, finding severities, metrics, and artifact references.
`test-genie provider-contract check workflow workflow-health` passes against a lifecycle-managed workflow-health instance.

requirements.title: Expose Provider CLI Commands
requirements.description: The workflow-health CLI must expose provider health, scenario validation, workflow list/show/search/run, and fix preview/apply commands with manifest-backed bindings and JSON output for agent use.

validation.notes: CLI manifest and runtime command coverage tests prove every documented provider command is discoverable and bound to the intended RPC or local operation.
